title: workflow.json
description: A workflow definition (C1): a graph of steps with one entry step and a definition of done. Loops are allowed, and there is no fixed exit step. One folder for each workflow in templates/workflows/. The runner (C2) reads it. The conditions are text: the session that does a step gives each true condition with the same words, and the runner compares the texts.

name.description: The workflow. It must be the same as the folder name.

purpose.description: One sentence: when a session uses this workflow.

entry.description: The id of the entry step.

done.description: The definition of done. A step with "done": true checks it.

executor.description: agent: one turn of a session. ask: a human answers with the question template. tool: a deterministic call.

instructions.description: What to do in the step.

session.description: Agent steps only: the session that does the step. Default: owner.

tool.description: Tool steps only: the name of the deterministic tool that the runner calls.

when.description: The entry condition of the step.

exit.description: The condition to leave the step.

templates.description: The message templates (kinds) that the step uses.

by.description: Who approves: user, orchestrator, parent, or a session type.

to.description: user, orchestrator, parent, or a session type.

next.description: The next steps. Each next step checks its condition. One valid: go there. Many valid: the agent picks. None: the run stops and asks.

done.description: True: this step can end the work. It checks the definition of done.
